CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_LimitLiabilityStatus_LNS
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityStatus AS (

SELECT
    BLL.LIMIT_B2KID AS LimitId
	,BLL.LCHG_TIME AS [Timestamp]
	,BLL.STATUS_CODE AS StatusCode
	,BLL.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BLL.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BLLD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.LNS_LIMITLIAB_DELTA BLLD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_LIMITLIAB BLL ON BLLD.LIMIT_B2KID = BLL.LIMIT_B2KID AND BLLD.BANK_ID = BLL.BANK_ID AND BLL.ISLATEST = 1
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityStatus FROM TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityStatus;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityStatus_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
LimitId
,[Timestamp]
,StatusCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, LimitId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityStatus WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityStatus_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
LimitId
,[Timestamp]
,StatusCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, LimitId
FROM BNKM.LimitLiabilityStatus --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'LNS'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityStatus_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.LimitId,TGT.LimitId) AS LimitId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityStatus_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityStatus_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.LimitId = TGT.LimitId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityStatus_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityStatus_DELTA;


---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	[LimitId] = SRC.LimitId
	,[Timestamp] = SRC.[Timestamp]
	,[StatusCode] = SRC.StatusCode
	,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,[SourceSystemCode] = 'LNS'
	,[TaskRunId] = 0
	,[WorkFlowId] = 0
	,[InsertDttm] = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.LimitLiabilityStatus TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityStatus_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.LimitId = TGT.LimitId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityStatus SRC ON SRC.LimitId = TGT.LimitId ;


-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO  BNKM.LimitLiabilityStatus
(
	LimitId
	,[Timestamp]
	,StatusCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
	[LimitId] = LimitId
	,[Timestamp] = [Timestamp]
	,[StatusCode] = StatusCode
	,[FinancialInstitutionId] = FinancialInstitutionId
	,[SourceSystemCode] = 'LNS'
	,[TaskRunId] = 0
	,[WorkFlowId] = 0
	,[InsertDttm] = InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityStatus
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityStatus;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilityStatus_DELTA;

END
